text: Testing plays a crucial role in software development. Unit tests check individual components in isolation, ensuring each function works correctly. Integration tests verify that different parts of the system work together smoothly. A popular approach is test-driven development (TDD), where you write a test before writing the actual code. This helps clarify requirements and catch issues early. Ultimately, a strong testing strategy builds confidence in the software. When you have reliable tests, you can make changes or add features without worrying about breaking existing functionality, leading to more stable and maintainable applications.
